title: Where outer hair cells deliver net power in a cochlear model of cat and human: model code, parameter files and scripts
description: Model code, fitted parameter files and scripts that produce the numbers, tables and figures of the article "Where outer hair cells deliver net power in a cochlear model of cat and human" (submitted to the Journal of the Acoustical Society of America) and of its supplementary material. The model is a one-dimensional long-wave transmission line with three-degree-of-freedom sections (basilar membrane, reticular lamina, tectorial membrane) and a saturating outer-hair-cell force. Python 3 with NumPy and SciPy.
